priorityList: Maintain poisons and enter Stealth before starting combat.
Activate Shadow Blades when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready to be used.
Activate Shadow Dance if you are out of Stealth, have low combo points, and either Secret Technique is ready or Darkest Night is active.
Use Vanish to generate combo points and enter Stealth if you have 1 or fewer combo points and 50+ energy.
Cast Secret Technique as your highest priority finisher during Shadow Dance or if its cooldown is nearly finished.
Use Shadowstrike to consume the Darkest Night buff if you have 5+ stacks of Shadow Techniques and Secret Technique is not ready.
Cast Eviscerate as a finisher if the Darkest Night buff is active.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Spend combo points on Eviscerate if Secret Technique and Coup de Grace are both unavailable.
Use finishers only when at 6 or more combo points (wait for 7 combo points if Darkest Night is active).
Use Shadowstrike to apply Deathstalker's Mark if the debuff is missing from your target.
Use Shadowstrike as your primary builder while in Stealth or Shadow Dance.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you have a deficit of 3 or more combo points.
Use Gloomblade (or Backstab) as your builder when not in Stealth or Shadow Dance and energy is above 60.
Sync offensive racials and on-use trinkets with your Shadow Blades burst window.
